method: Archived numerical reconstruction only; no new integration, MuJoCo import, viewer, policy inference, or source-model mutation.

finger_controller_audit.interpretation: The approximately 24 N raw request is attenuated to approximately 0.18 N by the registered free-motion inverse-mass implicit solve; this is mathematically expected for the archived M_ff^-1 and is not by itself an implementation error.

solver_constraint_audit.address_semantics: efc_address is the first scalar row for that contact; a contact with a 4-dimensional elliptic cone occupies address,address+1,address+2,address+3. efc_id repeats the contact index for each scalar row. The equality row precedes contact rows. efc arrays are constraint-row ordered and must not be indexed as if they were one-to-one with mjData.contact entries.
limitations: R2 archived timelines contain post-forward aggregate fields only and no per-row efc arrays.
Post-forward qacc/qfrc_constraint are recomputations after integration, not the preceding step's impulse history.
An integration-stage contact set and a post-forward contact set may differ; this difference is preserved rather than collapsed.

passive_arm_finding.interpretation: Zero commanded arm torque is not a mechanically fixed arm, but the archived passive trace has negligible arm velocity at contact loss. The finger/contact manifold change precedes the large finger velocity and peg rotation jump; this weakens an arm-torque-only explanation without proving contact solver uniqueness.

mechanism_assessment.free_motion_finger_prediction_error: NOT_FOUND; archived force matches registered equation
mechanism_assessment.finger_equality_constraints: PRESENT_AS_ONE_EQUALITY_ROW; separate equality impulse attribution unavailable in R2 archive

limitations: Contact positions are stored contact points/midpoints and do not prove a mesh feature, edge, or corner identity.
R2 post-forward qacc, qfrc_constraint, and contact forces are recomputed diagnostics, not historical integration impulses.
The saved R2-R1 EFC arrays expose type/id/address rows but not the full solver iteration history or separate equality/contact impulse decomposition.
This is no-policy evidence and does not establish PPO transfer or a universal contact-solver root cause.
